_doc: PLACEHOLDER-draft — Sérgio voice pass pending, EVERY display string below. R28-2d-i/ii (Session 34, docs/REINTERP_E2_HOMECOMING_SCRIPT_2026-07-12.md S2R.0-S2R.2): the E2 arrival — the return press, Lamby's debut, and the Restorify check-in shell (streak + Daily Realignment). `witness.*` values are the cold-side lines filed to ledger.lamby/ledger.checkins; resolved here, never composed in TS. R28-2d-iv (Session 35): `videoOffer*` — Lamby offers the New You Program video after the alert beat. SESSION 60 (docs/REINTERP_PLAYTHROUGH_E2_2026-07-26.md §A + Sérgio's own words, 'there is no boot up sequence for the new version of LambyOS… we need to be presented to Lamby'): the arrival now has FOUR beats where it had two — `osBoot*` (the updated machine boots and says so, with its jingle), `intro*` (Lamby presents HIMSELF — his debut, the whole point of the era's guidance lineage), `program*` (he presents RESTORIFY, so the two stop reading as competing systems and he has a job on arrival), then the check-in. Two conduction beats of exactly two lines each = 4 assistant lines across the arrival, inside both the ≤2-per-beat law (CLAUDE.md R28 amendment 2) and the ≤5-per-stage cap. Dismissal works at BOTH beats and files at both. `checkinResponses` answer the walk card (it used to resolve into nothing); `message*` is the notice that a message has arrived, so opening the Messenger is motivated rather than guessed at — the notice is Lamby's, the Messenger window it opens is felt and he is never inside it.
_osBootDoc: S2R.0b — THE BOOT. E1 boots with a BIOS crawl and a LambyOS crawl; the E2 version change used to pass unmarked (finding A2). The machine has been UPDATED and the boot is where it says so: a version line that names what it replaced, the profile coming back out of storage, and the companion process starting for the first time. `osBootTrack` is the jingle hook — no asset is committed yet, and src/audio/tapeAudio.ts's registry law means an unregistered name is simply never requested (no 404, no console error). Drop the file in public/assets/audio/, add one line to that registry, and the boot sings. ⛑ 2026-09-04, Sérgio: the hook now names `chase_the_clouds.mp3` — the FULL 30.77 s jingle, his own file, already in the repo and already registered. `lambyos_2003_boot.mp3` was a 6.5 s cut of it and he rejected all three cuts ("None of them, the 6 second doesnt fit"): the boot is not a startup sting, it is a CD-ROM splash, and a cut has no phrases left for the animation to land on. The 6.5 s file stays on disk — re-cutting is cheap and a short version is useful for review — but nothing points at it.
osBootLines: RESTORIFY IS NOW PART OF THIS COMPUTER.
osBootFooter: Your file was kept while you were away.

cartoon._doc: S166 / his 2026-09-21 call — the SOFTWARE's boot: Lamby asleep, a thought-cloud of static (never a picture), a monitor switching on and its light waking him, the screen writing what is right: the mark and a streak. The jingle (`osBootTrack`) plays over it and on under his introduction; the machine's own boot is silent now. Register: operable — the programme's cartoon of itself; the satire is its own and collapses on its own terms (the light that shows him what is right is a number on a screen).

introLine2: I came with the update. I'll be with you from now on.
programLine1: This is Restorify — your programme. I look after it for you.
programLine2: Shall we begin your Daily Realignment?
videoOfferLine2: I found something that helped others like you.
_checkinResponseDoc: Finding B7: 'how was your walk resolves into nothing — the card vanishes and jumps to the Messenger with nothing said.' Every answer is still ACCEPTED and still only REGISTERS (never branches — master plan §5b): the four replies differ in wording, not in consequence, which is exactly the register the differing witness tags already file. The response is the program's own voice (operable — it may glitter), not Lamby's, so it carries no assistant line count.

checkinResponses.line1: Steady is where we want you.
checkinResponses.line2: Filed. Your streak is safe today.
Struggle is part of the walk. It is on your file.
Filed. We will check again tomorrow.

_messageDoc: Finding B8: 'no notification that a message arrived — Lamby should tell you, so opening the Messenger is motivated.' One conduction beat, two lines, and BOTH answers work: Open takes you there; Not now files and leaves the Messenger sitting on the desktop with its unread mark — the era does not chase (S2R.1's dismissal law), it waits. Lamby is never drawn inside the Messenger itself (that window is felt).
messageLine1: A message came in while we were talking.
messageLine2: It's in your Messenger. Shall I open it?
dismissedToast: Restorify — Daily Realignment is on the desktop when you want it.
_docDismissedToast: ⚑ S150 (OPEN_ITEMS R3-49, Sérgio: 'what does the Not now button do?'): the dismissal always worked and filed, and nothing on screen said so. This is the SYSTEM's status-well toast after Not now — not Lamby (a dismissed conductor does not keep talking); it names where the program went. The window's 2003 look is Priority 4 (R3-41/50/51).
messageToast: A message came in while we were talking — press here to open your Messenger.
_docMessageToast: ⚑ S150 (OPEN_ITEMS R3-55, Sérgio 08-21 and 09-17: 'there is no need for the pop-up of Caleb'): the announcement is ONE line in the status well and the Messenger's dot — no card over the desktop. Lamby's voice, one beat, then quiet; the door stays open (the dot) and the era waits. `messageTitle/Line1/Line2/Open/NotNow` are kept for the record and unused.
